classic.title: Classic
classic.description: A traditional book page: Palatino-style type, centred small-capital headings, balanced margins, running heads and page numbers at the outer corners.
classic.best_for: General reading: treatises, histories, letters, anything without special layout needs.

classic-notes.title: Classic, Wide Note Margin
classic-notes.description: The Classic page with a wide outer margin divided from the text by a faint rule, for the reader's own notes. The look of the Councils, Papal Documents and Summa volumes.
classic-notes.best_for: Study editions: council decrees, encyclicals, theology, anything people annotate.
classic-notes.colour: black and white (canon and creed bars print grey)

note_rule.help: the faint rule beside the note margin

illuminated.title: Illuminated Manuscript
illuminated.description: After a Gothic book of hours: blackletter (or uncial) headings, gilded initial letters on painted grounds, titles and rubrics in red and blue, an ivy-and-bar border around each chapter opening, and an optional vellum page tint.
illuminated.best_for: Prayer books, psalters, offices, the Rule, lives of saints, gift and presentation editions.

text.help: Fell is an early printed face; Garamond is smoother

tint.help: vellum-coloured pages (printed to the edge, so the file gets bleed)

pilcrows.help: red and blue paragraph marks instead of indents

large-print.title: Large Print
large-print.description: 14-point type with generous line spacing, ragged right with no hyphenation, high contrast and bold headings. Sans-serif Atkinson Hyperlegible by default (designed for low vision), or a serif.
large-print.best_for: Readers with low vision; books to read aloud from; parish and classroom copies.

modern.title: Modern Clean
modern.description: Crisp sans-serif headings in a single accent colour, left-aligned chapter titles with plenty of white space, a readable serif body, and numbered steps, figures and tables styled for instruction.
modern.best_for: Trade and how-to books (carpentry, crafts), manuals, guides, contemporary non-fiction.
modern.colour: colour for the accent; graphite prints well in black and white

red-black.title: Red & Black Liturgical
red-black.description: Rubrics, titles and initials in red, text in black, Garamond type and narrow margins so Latin and English fit side by side. Red initial letters open each chapter.
red-black.best_for: Missals, breviaries, offices, prayer books, parallel-text editions.
red-black.colour: colour (red); choose rubric=black for black-and-white printing

rubric.help: black makes it a black-and-white book

two-column.title: Two-Column Reference
two-column.description: Compact Times-style type set in two columns with a hairline between them, bold run-in headings and tight margins: the most words per page.
two-column.best_for: Catechisms, commentaries such as the Catena Aurea, dictionaries, long reference works.

columns.help: 1 sets the same page in a single column

scriptorium.title: Scriptorium
scriptorium.description: Built from Anthony's Scriptorium design system: Cardo text in iron-gall ink on a vellum wash, blackletter titles, rubric labels in IM Fell small capitals, glosses in lapis italic, a gilded or vermilion drop cap opening each chapter, and the asymmetric folio of a real leaf (narrow gutter, wide outer margin, deep foot). Ornaments are type (❧ ✠ ⁂), never drawn borders.
scriptorium.best_for: Lectionaries, the Rule, florilegia, glossed texts, devotional books with commentary in the margin.
scriptorium.colour: colour (vermilion, lapis, gold; vellum ground); ground=white still needs colour for the rubrics

ground.help: vellum: tonal wash printed to the edge (file gets bleed); white: plain paper

ruling.help: plummet bounding lines around the text block, as pricked and ruled on a leaf

black-gold.title: Black & Gold
black-gold.description: Black cloth, gold frame and title: the plainest and most formal of the cloth covers.

forest-gold.title: Forest & Gold
forest-gold.description: Dark green cloth with antique-gold frame and a four-petal fleuron.

illuminated.title: Illuminated
illuminated.description: Vellum ground with a painted bar-and-ivy border, a gilded initial and blackletter title in red and blue. Pairs with the Illuminated Manuscript interior.

modern-block.title: Modern Block
modern-block.description: A white cover with a solid colour block, large left-aligned sans-serif title. Pairs with Modern Clean.

navy-silver.title: Navy & Silver
navy-silver.description: Midnight-navy cloth with silver frame, lettering and a star emblem.

oxblood-gold.title: Oxblood & Gold
oxblood-gold.description: Deep oxblood cloth with a double gold frame, gold title and emblem. The Councils jackets.

vellum.title: Vellum Title Page
vellum.description: A cream cover set like an early printed title page: black and red type inside a double red rule.

scriptorium.title: Scriptorium
scriptorium.description: From the Scriptorium design system: vellum wash, blackletter title in iron-gall ink, rubric labels in vermilion small capitals, glosses in lapis, a gilt double rule and a type ornament. Pairs with the Scriptorium interior.
